tips.text: Expect wrong-breed streaks; each breed is a flat 20% a roll, and four Chesa in a row is normal.
Stock several eggs and Incubator Power Cores before you start, then run incubations back to back.
Use a fast frame like Volt, Loki or Nova to break every Kubrow Den on a Grineer Forest Capture, such as Mantle on Earth.
Build the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment if you expect several rolls; it halves every wait.
Players call it a low-stress side activity; the 48-hour wait is the only complaint.
Budget about five eggs and five cores for a random Raksa.
